directed_response_contract.common_scale: within-cohort log2 abundance after a single frozen preprocessing route
directed_response_contract.overshoot: beta_DC*beta_ID<0 and abs(beta_ID)/abs(beta_DC)>1.00; report separately, never silently count as correction
directed_response_contract.standardized_effect_note: Hedges g and SE may be reported, but correction fraction is computed on a common unstandardized log2 scale because DC and ID Hedges g use different pooled SD denominators.

shared_arm_debiased_field_test.population_estimand: theta=<mu_D-mu_C,mu_D-mu_I>_K for a phenotype-blind positive-semidefinite sample kernel K
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.primary_kernel: phi_i=[1,unit_embedding_i]/sqrt(2); z_s=sum_i q_i*h_si*phi_i; K(s,t)=z_s^T*z_t, where h is phenotype-blind abundance and q is fixed full-universe ion-family capacity
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.world_mask_rule: mask inactive feature columns but never renormalize q after all/known-only/matched-known/shuffled-world projection
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.unbiased_estimator: offdiagonal_mean_K_DD-mean_K_DI-mean_K_CD+mean_K_CI; distinct disease animals supply the two disease terms
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.naive_bias_diagnostic: naive empirical-centroid estimate minus the off-diagonal U-statistic; report explicitly because shared disease-arm variance can manufacture positive correction
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.no_overshoot_gate: 0<theta/unbiased_MMD2(D,C)<=1, with the denominator stably positive; point eligibility never substitutes for a biological-unit interval
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.numerical_gate: one tolerance from the double-centred label-free K is shared by denominator, direction, contraction, no-overshoot and joint-score decisions; adding c*11T cannot change the verdict
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.joint_interpretation: directional projection, distance contraction and no overshoot are non-substitutable; orthogonal movement, movement beyond control and near-zero disease response are not correction
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.independence_boundary: Rows must be independent biological units. Collapse technical replicates; use a cluster-aware estimator for paired/longitudinal animals, litter/cage clusters or shared specimens.
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.kernel_boundary: K must be PSD and frozen without phenotype labels. Frozen embedding inner products are eligible; arbitrary non-PSD pair reranker scores are not silently converted into kernels. MMD is distance in this selected RKHS and implies full-distribution equality only under a characteristic kernel.
shared_arm_debiased_field_test.randomization_inference: Permute disease/intervention labels at fixed margins within predeclared blocks only under a documented equiprobable fixed-margin assignment. Report both directional and joint direction-plus-contraction-plus-no-overshoot p-values. Minimisation, adaptive or unequal-probability designs need their actual assignment distribution; otherwise no randomization p-value is permitted.

factorial_or_multiarm_axes.rule: estimate dbdb-db/m separately within eNOS background and ACE/ARB stratum; estimate ACE/ARB effect within db/db and each eNOS background; never pool into a three-arm rescue
fit diet, genotype and diet-by-genotype interaction; do not pool both heterozygous diet arms as one intervention
compare low/high NMN with the matched hypoxia arm separately within glucose strata; never pool doses or glucose strata before heterogeneity testing

phenotype_guard.rule: A protective direction is admissible only when renal function, kidney injury marker, kidney volume, survival or histology was assessed independently of the metabolomic readout and frozen before response scoring.

endpoint_linkage_tiers.A: renal endpoint is linked to the same biological animals used for metabolomics
endpoint_linkage_tiers.B: renal endpoint is from the same randomized experiment and arm, but animal-level linkage is unavailable
endpoint_linkage_tiers.C: primary paper supports the same intervention and disease model in a separate experiment only; expected-direction development use, not cohort-level rescue
endpoint_linkage_tiers.BLOCKED: no qualifying non-metabolomic efficacy endpoint or provenance cannot connect it to the intervention design

phenotype_guard.claim_rule_by_tier: Only A or B may support a cohort-level protective direction; only A permits animal-level phenotype-response coupling. C is a development prior and never a rescue truth label.

published_result_inconsistencies.impact: transition-only and transition pooled estimates must be recomputed; published phase labels are forbidden truth inputs

published_result_inconsistencies.publication_rule: disease-intervention effect between zero and disease-control effect with at least 40 percent attenuation; correction in at least 4 of 8 cohorts; sign consistency at least 60 percent
published_result_inconsistencies.v019_code_rule: abs(gDC)>=0.4, pDC<0.05, abs(gDI)>=0.3 and same sign; aggregate by cohort-polarity slice; candidate sign consistency at least 75 percent
published_result_inconsistencies.impact: all published H4 candidates are consumed hypotheses, not response truth

nonredundant_question: Can precursor-resolved, structurally unresolved MS2 entities and calibrated related-chemistry families carry reproducible directed disease and counter-response information across held-out MWB source families, and do they increase correct selective coverage beyond known-only and measurement-matched-known analyses without using disease, phase or model-class labels as relation truth?

evaluation_worlds.all: resolved plus unresolved eligible MS2 entities
evaluation_worlds.known_only: accepted structure or library-identified entities only
evaluation_worlds.measurement_matched_known: known entities matched to unresolved entities on source family, polarity, precursor-mass bin, prevalence, intensity missingness and MS2 count without outcome matching
evaluation_worlds.all_identity_field: the same all-entity abundance matrix, full-universe capacities and world mask with K_entity(i,j)=1[i=j]; required abundance-only baseline before crediting learned spectral relations
evaluation_worlds.unresolved_shuffled_ms2: shuffle unresolved spectrum assignments within source-family, instrument, polarity, precursor-mass and acquisition-density blocks while preserving abundance/effect vectors
evaluation_worlds.primary_endpoint: correct non-abstained source-family-held-out response retrieval coverage at a frozen false-linkage or FDR bound
evaluation_worlds.mechanism_gate: all must outperform all_identity_field on the same entities, abundances and capacities before a gain is credited to learned MS/MS chemical relations
secondary_endpoints: full spectral field versus all-entity identity-kernel mechanism increment

independence_rules.within_cohort_control_disease_interventi: causal-direction or counter-response check only, never cross-study generalization
independence_rules.recommended_additional_sensitivity: leave one institution or laboratory cluster out because four intervention projects originate from the same Nanjing institution
